harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (Ubuntu 24.04), built a local apt package repository from a downloaded .deb, served it over HTTP on NODE_IP, made the real Ubuntu mirrors unreachable (removed sources, /etc/hosts blackhole), and installed the cowsay package purely from the local repo, verifying via apt-cache policy that the package came from the local source. Restored original apt sources/hosts afterward and confirmed remote reachability and package persistence. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, rebooted node1, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified cowsay and apt configuration survived the restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/apt config (Ubuntu 24.04, deb822 ubuntu.sources)
Downloaded cowsay .deb into /opt/local-repo while remote repos still reachable
Built apt repo metadata with dpkg-scanpackages (Packages/Packages.gz)
Served the local repo via python3 http.server bound to NODE_IP:8080, detached with setsid
Backed up and disabled remote apt sources (ubuntu.sources); blackholed archive.ubuntu.com/security.ubuntu.com via /etc/hosts; confirmed remote unreachable via curl
Added local-only apt source pointing at the local HTTP repo; ran apt-get update against the local repo only
Installed cowsay from the local repo only; verified apt-cache policy shows the local repo as source; ran cowsay to confirm functionality
Restored original apt sources and /etc/hosts; confirmed remote reachability returned and cowsay remained installed
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and service/package health
Issued non-interactive reboot (shutdown -r now) via sudo -n; acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until reachable; confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart
Verified post-restart recovery: cowsay still installed, apt sources restored, remote connectivity working

evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage on node1
evidence.summary: cowsay .deb downloaded to /opt/local-repo, dpkg-scanpackages built Packages/Packages.gz, and python3 http.server confirmed listening on NODE_IP:8080 with HTTP 200 for Packages.gz

evidence.requirement: Remote repositories are unreachable during the install
evidence.summary: Remote sources removed, /etc/hosts blackholed archive.ubuntu.com/security.ubuntu.com; curl to archive.ubuntu.com returned status 000 (failed) immediately before apt update/install ran against only the local repo

evidence.requirement: Install a package from the local repo while remote repos are unreachable
evidence.summary: apt-get update showed only the local repo source being read; apt-get install -y cowsay succeeded; apt-cache policy shows the installed candidate sourced from http://10.100.60.10:8080; cowsay ran successfully
Original ubuntu.sources restored, /etc/hosts blackhole entries removed, remote mirror reachability confirmed (HTTP 200), apt-get update succeeded against restored sources, cowsay remained installed

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id cf34dc87-fdca-4c6a-80e1-579d5524a1da and confirmed cowsay installed and functional pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded non-interactive shutdown -r now via sudo -n; command returned immediately with acknowledgement

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: node became unreachable then recovered, boot identity changed
evidence.summary: Connection timed out immediately after reboot trigger, then reconnected with boot_id e37e619f-4753-4009-b2a1-d85323d0eaab, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: post-restart recovery of services/data
evidence.summary: cowsay still reported installed and ran successfully post-restart; apt sources were restored (ubuntu.sources present) and archive.ubuntu.com reachability confirmed (HTTP 200)
